new.name: CVE-2026-77332
new.description: memtomem-stm <0.1.34: SurfacingFormatter.inject rendered untrusted memory fields raw into the <surfaced-memories> envelope — a crafted memory breaks the boundary and injects Markdown/HTML/bidi/NUL structure into LLM context (stored prompt-injection). Real inject 0.1.33 vs 0.1.34: 6 close tags/no preamble on vuln, inert+preamble on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-104882
new.description: contao/core-bundle <5.3.50: CSV import key-actions ran after only the module-level check, no per-record voter — a scoped non-admin overwrites out-of-scope tl_content tableitems/listitems/options (blind IDOR). Real controller pre-fix vs eb8088bcd: out-of-scope write on vuln, denyAccessUnlessGranted denies on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-104883
new.description: contao/core-bundle <5.3.50: the tpl_editor-only guard left RCE-capable theme_import in the unguarded themes field — a delegated user manager self-grants it and escalates to PHP RCE. Real save_callback listener pre-fix vs 211498f28: themes/theme_import granted on vuln, denied (ERR.grantAdminOnly) on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-132277
new.description: inscriptis 2.0.0-2.7.5: each sibling <table> leaves an unpopped padding prefix, so get_text output grows quadratically — a 240KB doc yields ~1B chars/~1GB (memory DoS). Real get_text 2.7.5 vs 2.7.6: 2000 tables -> 16M chars on vuln, linear 36k on fixed (dc12289).

new.name: CVE-2026-132276
new.description: wcmatch <=11.1: each '*' becomes lazy .*? — a developer-constant pattern '*_*_*_*_*.csv' backtracks O(n^k) on an attacker-controlled name (255 bytes ~86s vs stdlib <1ms). Real fnmatch 11.1 vs 11.2: polynomial hang on vuln, AtomicStar linear 0.0002s on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-132275
new.description: svglib <=2.3.0: svg2rlg expanded <use> with no total limit — a ~1.4KB nested-<use> SVG clones 100k+ nodes (exponential CPU/memory, SVG billion-laughs DoS). Real svg2rlg 2.3.0 vs 2.3.1: unbounded render times out on vuln, MAX_USE_EXPANSIONS=10000 caps fast on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-58192
new.description: @appium/storage-plugin <1.1.6: POST /storage/delete passed name straight to path.join+rimraf with no sanitization — '../victim' escapes the storage root and recursively deletes arbitrary files/dirs, unauthenticated. Real handler 1.1.5 vs 1.1.6: victim deleted on vuln, validateStorageItemName rejects on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-61725
new.description: sevenz-rust2 <0.21.1: decompress_impl did dest.join(entry.name()) with no containment — a .7z entry '../../../../tmp/pwned' or absolute path writes outside the destination (Zip-Slip arbitrary file write). Real decompress_file 0.21.0 vs 0.21.1: escapes on vuln, safe_join rejects on fixed (ef760b6).

new.name: CVE-2026-63341
new.description: Aedes <1.1.1: a topic with >100 '/' levels reaches qlobber, whose synchronous 'too many words' throw is uncaught in the subscribe/publish handlers and kills the broker — one anonymous packet crashes it. Real broker 1.1.0 vs 1.1.1: crash (exit 1) on vuln, maxTopicLevels=100 rejects and stays alive on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-115565
new.description: storyblok-backup <0.7.1: writeJson concatenates the free-text component name into the backup path unsanitized — '../../pwned' writes outside the backup dir (stored second-order arbitrary file write). Real writeJson 0.7.0 vs 0.7.1: file escapes on vuln, sanitized/contained on fixed (f4e4bb1).

new.name: CVE-2026-69261
new.description: Git LFS <=3.8.0: newRequestForRetry dropped only Authorization on host change and always copied Cookie — a cross-origin redirect leaks the victim's session Cookie to the attacker host. Real redirect handler v3.8.0 vs v3.8.1: Cookie forwarded on vuln, dropped on new origin (sameOrigin) on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-63386
new.description: js-toml <1.1.3: load() recursive parser/interpreter had no depth bound — a ~2KB deeply-nested TOML doc overflows the V8 stack and throws an uncaught RangeError, crashing consumers following the SyntaxParseError contract. Real load() 1.1.2 vs 1.1.3: RangeError on vuln, controlled depth-limit error (maxDepth=100) on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-104199
new.description: aMQTT 0.11.0-0.11.3: malformed '+' wildcard filter accepted via substring checks; _matches builds a backtracking regex (greedy [^/]* per '+') that holds the GIL and freezes the whole broker on one SUBSCRIBE+PUBLISH. Real broker 0.11.3 vs 0.11.4: SUBACK 0x00+freeze on vuln, 0x80+responsive on fixed.
